name: Metamagic Rod, Dazing
body:
Aura strong (no school); CL 17th; Weight 5 lbs.

Price varies by specific type:

Lesser dazing metamagic rod 14,000 gp
Dazing metamagic rod 54,000 gp
Greater metamagic rod 121,500 gp

DESCRIPTION

The wielder can cast up to three spells per day that daze affected creatures as though using the Dazing Spell feat.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Rod, Dazing Spell

Cost varies by specific type:

Lesser dazing metamagic rod 7,000 gp
Dazing metamagic rod 27,000 gp
Greater dazing metamagic rod 60,750 gp
